lesson_title: The Cash Receipts Journal: Two Truths on One Line
hook_text: Every cash sale writes down TWO numbers — and only one of them is money.
clip_script: Saturday: R1 800 in the till from the day's sales. That is the money truth — into the money columns it goes. Now walk to the shelf: the goods that left had COST Lindi something. Her store marks everything up by 50 percent on cost, so goods that sold for R1 800 arrived on the shelf at R1 200. Reverse the mark-up: R1 800 divided by 1,5 equals R1 200. R1 800 in, R1 200 off the shelf — R600 gross profit made TODAY, and known today, not at year end.
visual_style: Split frame: a till filling with cash on one side, a shelf emptying on the other; the two numbers slide onto one glowing journal line.
pacing: Quick setup, slow-motion reveal of the division, snap ending on the profit figure.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to build the whole journal from a shoebox.
